description: This file defines the ContentDescription class, which models content description data within the application, including metadata and associated content, using JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: ContentDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing detailed descriptions of content, including metadata such as URL, keywords, title, and description, linked to a Content entity.

methods.name: getMetatagTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the meta title of the content description.

methods.name: setMetatagTitle
methods.description: Sets the meta title of the content description.

methods.name: getSeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the search engine friendly URL associated with the content.

methods.name: setSeUrl
methods.description: Sets the search engine friendly URL.

methods.name: getMetatagKeywords
methods.description: Retrieves the meta keywords for SEO purposes.

methods.name: getMetatagDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the meta description for SEO.
